answer: For agents tracking copper cargo at a wharf, pay once per certified scale per epoch, regardless of account count. Each scale uses a secure chip to sign its reading, epoch and hash of the cargo record encrypted with a cipher. Validators check the device certificate, signature and spent device-epoch pair; copying a receipt to another agent earns nothing. This assumes the issuer prevents duplicate device certificates and chip keys cannot be extracted. Scaling to n earning sources requires n certified scales, with purchase and operating costs, rather than n free keys.
